findings.title: Contrastive Learning-Based Audio to Lyrics Alignment for Multiple Languages
findings.finding: Contrastive cross-modal embeddings reach <0.2 s average absolute error on Jamendo — alignment-tailored alternative to CTC transcription loss.

findings.title: A Real-Time Lyrics Alignment System Using Chroma And Phonetic Features For Classical Vocal Performance
findings.finding: Live classical lyrics alignment combining chromagram with phonetic posteriorgrams under low-latency constraint.

findings.title: Adapting pretrained speech model for Mandarin lyrics transcription and alignment
findings.finding: Whisper adapted to Mandarin singing yields lyrics alignment MAE 0.071 s on polyphonic pop.
findings.implication: Pretrained-speech transfer to sung lyric timing.

findings.authors: He, Liu, Ye, Huang, Cui, Liu et al.
findings.title: RMSSinger: Realistic-Music-Score based Singing Voice Synthesis
findings.finding: Fine-grained SVS pipelines run MFA then manual phoneme/note edits because one vowel may span multiple notes; switches to word-level modeling.
findings.implication: MFA+manual; word-level vs phoneme-duration hard align.

findings.title: MFA Troubleshooting — singing atypical style
findings.finding: Official caveat: MFA is not intended to align single files that are long, noisy, or a different style such as singing — on-page only; further singing failure modes stay ·.
findings.implication: MFA singing caveat on-page; extras stay unverified.

findings.title: OpenUtau DiffSingerRhythmizerPhonemizer
findings.finding: Lyric→phonemes; ONNX rhythmizer inputs tokens/midi/midi_dur/is_slur → ph_dur; vowels stretched so note onsets align — note grid drives phone timing.

findings.title: OpenUtau DiffSingerVariance predict_dur
findings.finding: When predict_dur true, linguistic encode uses word_div/word_dur from vowel-grouped phones + note spans; else fixed ph_dur — dual path for predicted vs editor-fixed phone timing.
findings.implication: Predicted vs fixed phone timing paths.

findings.title: MakeDiffSinger README — MFA for acoustic training
findings.finding: Dataset pipeline names acoustic-forced-alignment make dataset from scratch with MFA for acoustic model training — MFA upstream labeling, not runtime score-lock.
findings.implication: MFA as DiffSinger dataset labeling only.

findings.title: Exploring Neural Transducers for End-to-End Speech Recognition (CTC vs attention)
findings.finding: CTC = hard monotonic latent alignments; attention = soft weighted frames. Holds for why CTC lyrics-to-audio ≠ lyrics-to-MIDI score-lock. Author per Verifier: Battenberg et al. (not Battenberg).

findings.title: Hybrid CTC/attention ASR
findings.finding: CTC constrains monotonicity; attention alone is too flexible for speech order — prefer hard note/lyric schedules over free soft attention for practice lock.

findings.title: music21 lyricTimingsFromEvents / MIDI translate
findings.finding: Music IR keeps lyric meta timestamps separate from Note pitch/time — dual IR clocks; one Lyric tick does not encode melisma across many MIDI notes.

findings.title: pretty_midi Lyric container
findings.finding: pretty_midi Lyric events are separate from Note objects — dual-clock analog for lyric vs note schedules.
